test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(360, 12, 60)
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: Second number × Third number ÷ 2 = First number.**

First we will check all the options.

1) (362, 13, 54) = (13 × 54) ÷ 2 = 351 ≠ 362

2) (342, 19, 36) = (19 × 36) ÷ 2 = 342 = 342

3) (369, 15, 78) = (15 × 78) ÷ 2 = 585 ≠ 362

4) (398, 16, 34) = (16 × 34) ÷ 2 = 272 ≠ 362

Hence, the correct answer is** "(342, 19, 36)".**
